verdict.rationale: Lever's developer docs show a REST-ish API covering candidates/applications, webhooks, OAuth, and audit events, indicating meaningful API coverage of core recruiting objects, but there is no evidence that UI-only features (career site builder, analytics dashboards, Automation Hub, AI features like Talent Fit or AI Form Builder) are exposed via the API, nor any explicit parity claim between UI and API capabilities. missing for 10: documentation of API parity for career site builder, analytics/reporting dashboards, automation hub rules, and AI features; any explicit vendor statement of UI/API feature parity.
